_comment: Paths that PCRecomp's heuristic audit flags but that were reviewed by hand. Patterns are fnmatch. Every entry needs a reason a reader can check. Nothing derived from the game binaries may ever be listed here.
android/branding/icono.png: The app icon supplied by the project owner; not a file from the game. Flagged because any PNG is treated as possible extracted artwork. Note: it depicts the game's logo and character (KNOWN_ISSUES B4).
android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_lau: Launcher icons generated from android/branding/icono.png by tools/make_icons.py.
runtime/h2_dispatch.c: Hand-written dispatcher. Flagged for its file name (*_dispatch.c) and because it declares lifted symbols through an X-macro; the table itself comes from recomp/generated/*/funcs_list.h, which is git-ignored. It contains no guest addresses.
